verdict.rationale: The Solo 2 firmware source is public on GitHub (solokeys/solo2), with documented build, compile and flash instructions. Community commenters describe it as open-source firmware. It is not open hardware, since it runs on an NXP LPC55S69. Missing for 10: the specific license is not named anywhere in the evidence, the hardware design is not open, and there is no first-party statement of the licensing terms.
